card.name: Linking words inside lists of substances
card.fires_on: Commas, "and", or "its" that come right after a named substance in a list of pollutants, irritants or drugs. Often "its" after a drug name, before "metabolites".

modes.label: Comma or and in pollutant lists
modes.description: A comma or "and" after one pollutant or irritant, where another substance is expected next.
modes.example: Valley air carries bits of dirt, toxic metals, ammonia from farm fertilizer<<,>> ozone that irritates nasal tissues.

modes.label: "its" after a drug name
modes.description: The word "its" after a drug name and "and", pointing to the drug's metabolites.
